theme: Client Testimonial: Incentive Trip That Redefined Team Performance

linkedin.text:
A VP of Sales told us something after their incentive trip that I keep coming back to:

"I've run incentive trips before. This was the first time the team came back and actually performed differently."

That sentence captures exactly why incentive travel, done right, is a business tool — not a reward budget line.

The structure matters. The destination choice matters. The moments you engineer between sessions matter. When those three align, you don't just get a trip people enjoyed — you get a team that returns with a different operating mode.

We've built that outcome across 1,500+ events, in 130+ destinations, for 25,000+ participants.

If you're scoping an incentive program and want a frank conversation about what drives post-trip performance — send me a DM. Happy to share what the data from our programs actually shows.
